prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a small old hill village of farmers and storytellers. thick golden-brown straw thatch roof cream plaster walls with dark timber framing and a stone plinth. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 176 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: EDIT THE USER-ATTACHED LAYOUT GUIDE into ONE isolated pixel-art JRPG village house sprite. Treat the attached image as a STRICT pixel-position blueprint, not merely inspiration. Output same image dimensions/aspect (176 by 160 art pixels, upscaled 7x per pixel if rendered at 1232x1120). Preserve the EXACT exterior outline, roof-to-wall division, and EXACT positions and sizes of BOTH yellow windows and the dark-brown ground-level walk-through DOOR if present in the original source (never move or replace openings). Roof occupies upper large rectangular volume, front plaster wall the lower volume straight-on, classic 3/4 top-down game building; no perspective vanishing point or side wall. The roof is thick golden-brown straw thatch seen from above, densely layered broad hand-placed straw pixel clusters with restrained warm-gold highlights, russet and muted purple-brown shadow accents, thick uneven straw eave on roof/wall division. Lower façade is warm cream plaster with worn dark-brown timber-frame vertical and horizontal beams, restrained stone plinth. The TWO existing windows are small amber glowing panes divided by dark mullions; existing actual door remains at ground level, a normal usable dark-brown wooden door, visible unblocked. Small flower boxes may be underneath windows, modest carved timber joinery, slight roof ridge if appropriate. PREMIUM modern hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG sprite: strictly uniform big CRISP square pixels in every detail, no subpixel details, no antialias, blur, soft painting, photography, noise, checkerboard dithering or gradients. Cohesive small clusters (3–10 art pixels), clean rich earthy hue-shifted ramps 4–6 shades per material; soft neutral even overcast illumination from upper left, glowing windows are the ONLY luminous elements, no exterior lighting pools. BACKGROUND IS FULLY TRANSPARENT alpha: replace every magenta region of source with transparent, no magenta fringe. No ground, no cast shadow, people, letters or text. Preserve all layout proportions rather than zooming or extending building.
